phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Superconducting quantum computer system utilizing a dilution refrigerator for cryogenic cooling to millikelvin temperatures, incorporating superconducting qubits made typically from Josephson junction circuits and integrated control/readout electronics.

The dilution refrigerator provides the requisite ultra-low temperature environment critical for superconducting qubit operation and is a distinct complex system integrated with control electronics and qubit chips.
